outcome: Side effects of nifedipine (tachycardia, hypotension, headache)
cohort: The study included 138 pregnant women between 28 and 34 weeks of gestation who were diagnosed with preterm labor.
finding: Nifedipine was effective in prolonging preterm labor in 84.78% of cases and was associated with minimal and manageable side effects.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery was vaginal in 94.93% of the cases.
